purpose: design and operate the network so services can reach each other as intended and nothing else, with changes controlled
entry_criteria: Connectivity requirements between systems and users exist
Address plan and zones are defined
procedure: Define zones and the allowed flows between them; default is deny.
Plan address ranges so they do not overlap with partners or other environments.
Implement routing, firewalls and segmentation from code, with each rule tied to a requirement.
Test allowed flows and test that forbidden flows fail.
Monitor latency, loss and denied traffic, and review rules regularly for stale entries.
Control changes with review, a window and a rollback for production.
deliverables: rules as code with requirement references
acceptance_criteria: Default is deny and each rule references a requirement
Allowed and forbidden flows were both tested
Production changes had approval and rollback

validation.command: nc -zv db.internal 5432   # example from the app zone
nc -zv db.internal 5432   # example from an unrelated zone

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: The database zone accepts connections only from the application zone on one port. A test from the application zone connects; the same test from the build zone is refused.
